content: Received the Research Tuition Scholarship at City University of Hong Kong.
Our work on circular holographic MIMO appears in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications, Volume 25.
Started my PhD in Computer Science at City University of Hong Kong, supervised by Prof. Yuguang “Michael” Fang.
Completed my master's degree at UESTC and was recognized as an Outstanding Graduate of Sichuan Province.
Received the National Scholarship for Graduate Students.
